units.source_text: 此诗全无怨恨之意，只是这简单的两句，对昨夜之事避而不谈。

en.t: This poem contained no resentment at all; in just those two simple lines, it avoided any mention of what had happened the night before.

units.source_text: 大女公子看了想道：“如此看来，他想不露痕迹地敷衍一下，就此离开了。”

en.t: After reading it, the elder princess thought, "It seems he means to smooth things over without leaving any trace and then go away like this."
The gentlewomen urged her, "Write a reply quickly!"

units.source_text: 大女公子想叫妹妹写，不好意思开口；

en.t: The elder princess wanted to have her younger sister write it, but she was too embarrassed to say so;
Taking up the brush herself was difficult as well.
After hesitating for a while, she finally wrote:
